purpose: Independent practice of B2.1 (relationship between add/sub) and B2.2 (subtraction facts to 10). Captures formative evidence on fact-family completion.
student_learning_goal: I can recall subtraction facts up to 10, and write the four-fact family for any addition fact.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can recall subtraction facts up to 10, and write the four-fact family for any addition fact.
header.character_watermark: Minnie the Minus Mouse in the top-right corner with a magnifying glass and a red '-' kerchief. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Each triangle holds a fact family. Write all four facts (or three, if it is a doubles triangle).
parts.visual_layout: Top half of the page. Six fact-family triangles arranged in a 2x3 grid. Each triangle has all three numbers shown (sum at top, two addends at bottom). Below each triangle: 4 equation lines (or 3 for doubles).

image_placeholders.description: Six fact-family triangles in B&W line-art, 2-row × 3-column grid. Each triangle ~1.6in tall. All three numbers shown on each triangle: T1 (3,5,8), T2 (4,4,8 — doubles), T3 (6,3,9), T4 (5,5,10 — doubles), T5 (7,2,9), T6 (6,4,10). Below each triangle, 4 equation lines (3 for doubles). Doubles triangles get an extra label: 'Doubles — only 3 facts!'
image_placeholders.placement: Top half; six triangles in 2x3 grid.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P1_SIX_TRIANGLES: keywords (triangles, facts) name what the triangles show.

parts.student_instructions: Each scene shows the total counters in a ten-frame, with some hidden under a cup. Write the subtraction equation (total - visible = hidden). Then write the related addition fact.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of the page. Four cup-hide scenes in a 2x2 grid. Each scene shows a ten-frame with some counters visible and a small cup illustration covering the rest. Below each scene: 'Subtraction: ___ - ___ = ___' and 'Addition: ___ + ___ = ___'.

image_placeholders.description: Four cup-hide scenes in B&W line-art, 2-row × 2-column grid. Each scene ~3in × 1.8in. Each shows a single ten-frame with some cells filled (counters visible) and a small overturned-cup illustration covering the remaining cells. Pre-fills: C1 — total 7, visible 4 (cup covers 3); C2 — total 9, visible 5 (cup covers 4); C3 — total 8, visible 6 (cup covers 2); C4 — total 10, visible 3 (cup covers 7). Below each scene, two equation lines.
image_placeholders.placement: Middle of the page; four scenes in 2x2 grid.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P2_FOUR_CUPS: keywords (cup, ten-frame, hidden) name what the scenes show.

parts.student_instructions: Draw a line from each subtraction fact on the left to its related addition fact on the right.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. Two columns. Left column: 6 subtraction facts. Right column: 6 addition facts (in scrambled order). The child draws lines connecting each subtraction to its addition partner.

image_placeholders.description: Two-column matching layout in B&W line-art. Each column has 6 fact boxes. Left column subtractions (top to bottom): 8-5, 9-4, 7-2, 10-6, 8-3, 9-7. Right column additions (top to bottom, scrambled): 5+2, 4+5, 6+4, 5+3, 2+7, 3+5. Boxes have light-grey outlines.
image_placeholders.placement: Bottom of the page; full-width two-column layout.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P3_TWO_COLUMNS: keywords (match, subtraction, addition) name what the columns ask for.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, flip the page over and write THREE fact-family triangles of your own. Pick any three sums between 6 and 10. Write all four facts for each triangle (or three for doubles).
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation. Hand out at the end of the Action phase. Watch for: (a) Part 1 children who write only TWO facts (the additions) and miss the subtractions — flag for cup-hide reteach; (b) Part 1 children who write 4 facts on a doubles triangle — flag for the doubles-special discussion; (c) Part 2 children who get the subtraction but not the related addition — flag for the addition-as-tool reteach; (d) Part 3 children who use trial-and-error for matching rather than fact-family logic — flag for explicit fact-family practice.
